sourceBlueprint.title: Generation Control Repo Studio
sourceBlueprint.mechanic: Compare code-backed generation papers on prompt control, restoration fidelity, one-step synthesis, and artifact containment.

seedPapers.title: GDPO-SR: Group Direct Preference Optimization for One-Step Generative Image Super-Resolution
seedPapers.problem: GDPO-SR is about one-step image super-resolution that still preserves fine local texture. The everyday problem is enlarging a low-resolution image while making smooth regions clean and textured regions sharp.

seedPapers.title: Bridging Fidelity-Reality with Controllable One-Step Diffusion for Image Super-Resolution
seedPapers.problem: CODSR is about one-step super-resolution that looks realistic without losing faithfulness to the low-quality input. The everyday problem is that generative priors can invent detail, but pure fidelity can leave images blurry.

seedPapers.title: Resolving Endpoint Underfitting in Diffusion Bridges via Noise Alignment
seedPapers.problem: This diffusion-bridge paper is about fixing weak performance near the clean endpoint of an image-restoration path. The everyday problem is that a model can learn most of the journey from degraded to clean but still miss the final sharp correction at the target

seedPapers.title: Low-Rank Residual Diffusion Models
seedPapers.problem: This paper is about restoration when the damaged image is already close to the desired image. The everyday problem is that standard diffusion wastes effort generating everything, even though only a small correction may be needed.

seedPapers.title: Residual Diffusion Bridge Model for Image Restoration
seedPapers.problem: This paper is about restoring damaged images without disturbing clean regions. The everyday problem is that a restoration model should repair degradation locally rather than repaint the entire image.
